feedback.loadFailed: Failed to load settings. Refresh and try again.

siteName.label: Site name
siteName.description: Shown in browser titles, authentication pages, and emails.

siteDescription.label: Site description
siteDescription.description: Shown in page metadata and the home page.

siteUrl.label: Site URL
siteUrl.description: Public URL used for email links and OAuth callbacks. Must start with http:// or https://.

siteImage.label: Site icon
siteImage.description: Icon URL used for the browser tab and site logo.

startTime.label: Launch time
startTime.description: Optional. When set, the home page displays the service uptime.

termsUrl.label: Terms of Service URL
termsUrl.description: Leave empty to hide it. Supports a full URL or internal path.

privacyUrl.label: Privacy Policy URL
privacyUrl.description: Leave empty to hide it. Supports a full URL or internal path.

icpBeian.label: ICP filing number
icpBeian.description: Leave empty to hide it from the footer.

policeBeian.label: Public security filing number
policeBeian.description: Leave empty to hide it from the footer.

policeBeianCode.label: Online filing number
policeBeianCode.description: Used by the public security filing link in the footer. Leave empty to open the search page, or enter a number to look up that filing.

enabled.label: Enable daily check-in
enabled.description: When disabled, the check-in action is unavailable and the API rejects requests.

cooldown.label: Cooldown mode
cooldown.description: Hourly cooldown starts after the last check-in; fixed time refreshes availability daily.

refreshHours.label: Cooldown interval (hours)
refreshHours.description: Minimum time between check-ins. Default: 24 hours.

fixedRefreshTime.label: Refresh time (HH:mm)
fixedRefreshTime.description: The daily time when check-in becomes available again.

reward.label: Reward mode
reward.description: Fixed mode grants the same amount each time; range mode selects a random integer between the minimum and maximum.

validation.fixedTime: Use the HH:mm format, for example 00:00
validation.amountRange: Minimum credits must not exceed maximum credits

mode.label: Registration mode
mode.description: Controls account creation through regular and third-party registration.

inviteCode.label: Site invitation code
inviteCode.configuredDescription: Configured. Leave empty to keep it, or enter a new value to rotate it.
inviteCode.initialDescription: Invitation mode requires a code with at least 8 characters.
inviteCode.required: Set an invitation code with at least 8 characters

passwordReset.label: Enable password reset
passwordReset.description: Controls the login link and password reset APIs.

emailActivation.label: Email activation
emailActivation.description: Require new users to activate their account through email.

emailFilter.label: Registration email filter
emailFilter.description: Off allows all domains; allowlist permits listed domains; blocklist rejects listed domains.
emailFilter.disabledDescription: Rules are ignored while filtering is off.
emailFilter.rulesDescription: Separate domains with commas or new lines and omit {'@'}.

defaultSession.label: Default session lifetime (seconds)
defaultSession.description: Applies when Remember me is not selected; activity renews the session.

absoluteSession.label: Absolute session limit (seconds)
absoluteSession.description: Maximum lifetime from the first login before you must sign in again.

rememberSession.label: Remember me lifetime (seconds)
rememberSession.description: Used when Remember me is selected.

emailVerification.label: Email verification expiration (minutes)
emailVerification.description: Lifetime of registration and email-change verification links.

forceBinding.label: Require an existing account
forceBinding.description: Unregistered OAuth identities may only link to an existing account.

clientId.label: Client ID
clientId.placeholder: Enter the OAuth app client ID

clientSecret.label: Client Secret
clientSecret.savedDescription: Configured. Leave empty to keep unchanged.

callbackUrl.label: Callback URL
callbackUrl.description: Generated from the site URL. Add it to the OAuth app allowlist.

scopes.label: Scopes
scopes.description: Fixed by provider; no configuration is required.

feedback.saveFailed: Failed to save third-party login settings
feedback.copyFailed: Copy failed. Select and copy manually.

diagnostics.title: Current request resolution
diagnostics.description: Resolve the current admin request with the active configuration to verify the proxy chain and headers.
diagnostics.loadFailed: Unable to load client IP diagnostics

reasons.direct: Direct mode uses the connected peer IP
reasons.trusted_proxy: The peer is trusted and the client IP was read from its header
reasons.untrusted_proxy: The peer is not trusted, so the proxy header was ignored
reasons.missing_header: The trusted proxy did not provide the selected header; the peer IP was used
reasons.invalid_header: The header contains an invalid IP; the peer IP was used
reasons.insufficient_forwarded_hops: X-Forwarded-For does not contain enough hops; the peer IP was used
reasons.peer_unavailable: The connected peer IP is unavailable

safeFallback.title: Fell back to direct mode
safeFallback.description: The saved proxy configuration is incomplete or invalid. Fix the trusted proxy list to activate the selected proxy mode.

management.lockedTitle: This configuration is managed by environment variables
management.lockedDescription: NUXT_PROXY_SOURCE or the legacy NUXT_PROXY_TRUSTED_CIDRS is configured. The effective values are shown here; update the deployment environment and restart the service to change them.

settings.title: Client IP source
settings.description: Controls which address is used by rate limits, API key IP allowlists, login history, and audit logs. Invalid proxy data always falls back to the connected peer.

source.label: Resolution mode
source.description: Choose the mode that matches the actual network topology. Direct mode never reads proxy headers.

direct.label: Direct
direct.description: Use the socket peer IP when the application is directly exposed.

cloudflare.label: Cloudflare
cloudflare.description: Read CF-Connecting-IP only from a trusted connected proxy.

xForwardedFor.label: X-Forwarded-For
xForwardedFor.description: Resolve X-Forwarded-For from the right using the configured trusted hop count.

trusted.label: Trusted proxy IP / CIDR
trusted.description: Separate entries with commas or new lines. A single IPv4 / IPv6 address becomes /32 or /128. Use 0.0.0.0/0 and ::/0 for all IPv4 and IPv6 addresses.

validation.required: Proxy modes require at least one trusted proxy IP or CIDR
validation.tooMany: A maximum of 256 trusted proxies is allowed

allWarning.title: An entire address family is trusted
allWarning.description: 0.0.0.0/0 or ::/0 lets any peer in that address family supply the client IP header. Use this only when the application port is fully isolated by a firewall or private proxy network.

cloudflare.title: Cloudflare headers still require origin isolation
cloudflare.description: Ensure the trusted reverse proxy overwrites CF-Connecting-IP and prevent external traffic from bypassing Cloudflare to reach the origin.

forwardedHops.label: Trusted forwarded hops
forwardedHops.description: Count hops from the right side of X-Forwarded-For, from 1 to 10. A single Nginx proxy normally uses 1.

type.label: CAPTCHA provider
type.description: Select a provider. Cloudflare Turnstile is currently supported.

siteKey.label: Site key
siteKey.description: Site key from the Cloudflare Turnstile application. It is a public identifier and is shown in plain text.

secretKey.label: Secret key
secretKey.description: Secret key from the Cloudflare Turnstile application.
secretKey.configuredDescription: Configured. Leave empty to keep unchanged.

passwordReset.label: Password reset CAPTCHA
passwordReset.description: Validated when requesting a reset link.

checkin.label: Daily check-in CAPTCHA
checkin.description: Shown before a user checks in.

fromName.label: Sender name
fromName.description: Name shown as the sender; leave empty to show only the address.

fromAddress.label: Sender email
fromAddress.description: Address used to send email; it is also used as the EHLO domain.

username.label: SMTP username
username.description: Usually the same as the sender email.

password.label: SMTP password
password.configuredDescription: Configured. Leave empty to keep unchanged.

replyTo.label: Reply-to address
replyTo.description: Address that receives replies; defaults to the sender.

secure.label: Force SSL
secure.description: Use an SSL connection, commonly with port 465.

poolMaxAge.label: SMTP connection lifetime (seconds)
poolMaxAge.description: Connections are reused during this period. Zero disables reuse.

test.label: Test email
test.description: Send a test message using the saved SMTP configuration.

testModal.title: SMTP test email
testModal.description: A test message will be sent using the saved SMTP configuration.

project.description: An integrated platform for publishing, connecting, and operating public APIs, with clear workflows for both API providers and consumers.
project.githubAriaLabel: View OpenAPI on GitHub; opens in a new window

capabilities.title: Core capabilities
capabilities.description: A complete but direct workflow for onboarding, publishing, consuming, and operating public APIs.

accounts.label: Accounts and permissions
accounts.description: Handles sign-in, role-based access, API keys, and user self-service in one place.

apis.label: API management
apis.description: Manages APIs, categories, HTTP methods, pricing rules, availability, and reporting behavior.

audit.label: Logs and auditing
audit.description: Records API calls, sign-ins, credit changes, and administrative actions with clear actor identities.

operations.label: Platform operations
operations.description: Supports announcements, notifications, partner links, redemption codes, and credit programs.

configuration.label: System configuration
configuration.description: Centralizes site, email, CAPTCHA, session, security, and network settings.

stack.title: Technical foundation
stack.description: A focused set of mature tools keeps the application type-safe and maintainable end to end.

nuxt.label: Nuxt 4 / Vue 3
nuxt.description: Composition API and file-based routing organize client and server features.

ui.label: Nuxt UI / Tailwind CSS
ui.description: Provides consistent, responsive interfaces for administrative workflows.

nitro.label: Nitro / H3
nitro.description: Runs server APIs, authentication middleware, and the Node.js application runtime.

database.label: Drizzle ORM / PostgreSQL
database.description: Keeps schemas, queries, and migrations type-safe.

tooling.label: VueUse / Zod
tooling.description: Supplies reusable composables and structured validation at system boundaries.
